sourceDesign.provenanceNote: T13 (PAF-13) provenance. The tracked .pen was opened only through Pencil MCP (read-only Get visitors, then Export from a scratch copy whose SHA-256 equals the tracked source and the paf-6/7/8/10/12 manifests); it was not modified. Dedicated statistics frames exist and were not used by T10: RN0yw, RRuhH, z6vIR, QVLTH, GrkSH, khmeK, o9iaC1, m8Loju. Match history detail BcpYH is the group-detail source. No dedicated frame exists for the paginated match history LIST or for a chart/data-table pairing; those adapt component truth (Card RMese, Button B3Uqv, Text link QFH5u) and the Past Matches frame w25dY, and the state-variant frame x2GG9U. Frame existence is verified Pencil-side; test/statistics.visual-references.test.ts only validates manifest structure, component names, coverage, tolerances, PNG digests and ID format.

frames.provenance: approved PNG and budgets live in e2e/references/paf-10/manifest.json

playerStatistics.adaptation: Production renders the full metric inventory (matches, sets, games, rating, form, activity chart with data table, set patterns, records, peaks, partner and opponent records) where the frames show three highlight tiles and a handful of cards. Every figure is an evidence state (reason text, never 0 or blank). The frames' Home/Matches/Community/Ranking/Profile bottom navigation, the mode label and the flow annotations are app-shell or design notes, not statistics UI. The activity chart is a numeric SVG with a text equivalent and a data table; no frame draws it (chart intent from vARtQ:T5Zak).

filters.adaptation: Production shows the filters inline as a Base UI form with native selects and UTC date inputs plus Apply and Reset (the frame stacks scope cards and shows type options as a text row). Labels, helper text and the range error are i18n keys; controls are at least 44px.

pairStatistics.adaptation: The unordered-pair label becomes the localized heading and subtitle; the frame's league-history text row is a list of leagues played together; recent matches are a data table with row links and a Show more control when more pages exist. The back affordance is a breadcrumb plus a Back to player statistics link carrying the active filters; the frame shows a chevron title.

opponentStatistics.adaptation: Head-to-head is always from the focal player's view; no toughest-opponent label (frame note). Production adds average opponent level, upset wins and rating evidence from the same record and shows recent meetings as a table with a rating column. Breadcrumb and back link replace the chevron title.

visualBudgets.measurementMethod: U8 captures each production route at 390 CSS px width (deviceScaleFactor 1) and compares the clipped content region with the same region of the matching 2x Pencil PNG downsampled by 2 (pinned perceptual threshold), plus Playwright screenshot regression against the first-implementation captures. Structural probes (order, gutters, card radius token, containment, row stacking, 44px targets, no overflow, chart-table value equality) assert geometry exactly and independently of these budgets.

perScreenRationale.playerStatistics: Measured residual 0.155019 plus margin (see measurementNote). Production lists every metric as label, value and help text where RN0yw shows three tiles and cards, so page height and row content differ by design; the compared region is the aligned top block only. Raster is cross-renderer and live-data sensitive; layout defects are caught by structural probes.
perScreenRationale.filters: Unmeasured ceiling (no raster comparison; structural probes only). Production uses native selects and date inputs with 44px targets, helper text and a reset action; m8Loju draws scope cards and a text row of type options.
perScreenRationale.pairStatistics: Measured residual 0.178239 plus margin (see measurementNote). Live player names, a record table and a recent-matches table replace the frame's mock cards and chevron title; breadcrumb and back link are added.
perScreenRationale.opponentStatistics: Measured residual 0.174678 plus margin (see measurementNote). Same live-data and table differences as the pair surface, plus the rating column and opponent level evidence.
perScreenRationale.matchHistory: Highest ceiling: no dedicated frame, the reference is component and pattern truth only. Rows follow live status, outcome and rating data; screenshot regression against first-implementation captures is the primary raster check.
perScreenRationale.groupDetail: Measured residual 0.153934 plus margin (see measurementNote). Captured against the friendly 3-set fixture (g3) because BcpYH is a friendly match with three set lines; production still renders more sections than BcpYH (outlook, meta facts, audit timeline) and live player names and scores.
perScreenRationale.communityStatistics: Measured residual 0.154454 plus margin (see measurementNote). Production renders filters, volume, leaders, pairings and weekly and monthly charts with data tables where o9iaC1 shows three cards and a text row.

previousMeasuredResiduals.note: U8 captures taken before the F1/F7-F9/F11 restructuring to the Pencil frames; kept for audit. Residuals rose for player/pair/opponent because the restructured top blocks now draw filter sections and cards that the frames show in a different vertical rhythm and with live data; groupDetail fell because the capture now uses a friendly 3-set fixture like BcpYH instead of a competitive 2-set one.

visualBudgets.measurementNote: Re-measured for F10 iteration 2 by e2e/statistics-visual.spec.ts at 390x844 CSS px, light, en, deviceScaleFactor 1, top block of each route against the same region of the 2x Pencil PNG downsampled by 2 (YIQ perceptual threshold 0.1, changed-pixel ratio). Budget = measured residual + 0.03 cross-renderer margin, rounded up to 0.01. Residuals are repeatable to 3 decimals across runs. Re-measured after the Pencil-frame restructuring (see previousMeasuredResiduals); the groupDetail capture uses the friendly fixture g3 (friendly, 3 set lines, draw with an unfinished third set) to match BcpYH's match type; BcpYH shows a finished 2-1 win, so the g3 outcome label, rating-effect copy (no rating impact) and set-state badges differ by data, not by structure. They are dominated by live names, numbers and the extra production sections the mock frames do not draw, not by layout: layout is certified separately by structural probes over 3 viewports x 2 themes x 3 locales. filters and matchHistory keep their declared ceilings because no raster comparison exists for them: filters render inside the community route (probed structurally) and the history list has no dedicated Pencil frame. The error state is covered by the player-error-state.png screenshot regression (maxDiffPixelRatio 0.002).
visualBudgets.honesty: Budgets for playerStatistics, pairStatistics, opponentStatistics, communityStatistics and groupDetail are measured values plus a small margin. filters and matchHistory are unmeasured ceilings. No budget may be raised to hide a structural defect: required regions, their order and element counts are asserted separately from the raster by the composition probes (see compositionProbes), so a missing or reordered frame region fails regardless of budget. Three player/pair/opponent budgets rose after the restructuring; the rise is raster rhythm and live-data difference, not a structural gap, and every region the frames require is probed. Documented adaptations (regions the frames draw but production does not) are listed in compositionProbes.adaptations.

compositionProbes.method: e2e/statistics-visual.spec.ts 'composition follows the Pencil frames' runs per locale (en, pt-BR, es) at 320 and 390 CSS px, light. DOM assertions check region presence, counts, visibility and horizontal containment; document order and live top coordinates check region ordering, while top-level section rectangles check overlap. Player highlight tiles assert two columns at 320 and three at 390. An additional finalized-meetings fixture exposes conditional pair and opponent Show more controls for visibility, 44px minimum and containment checks. These geometry checks do not depend on raster budgets.
